def solve(G, verbose=False):
    H,W = len(G), len(G[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(x for row in G for x in row)
    content = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # simpler: marker rows = rows containing a value that is not content and not the row's dominant separator

    # separator color: the non-content color appearing in full lines
    nonc = Counter(x for row in G for x in row if x!=content)
    # markers: values that appear in < half of marker-row cells
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x!=content for x in G[r])]
    # determine separator = most common non-content value overall
    sep = nonc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x not in (content,sep) for x in G[r])]
    mcols=[c for c in range(W) if any(G[r][c] not in (content,sep) for r in range(H))]
    R,C=len(mrows),len(mcols)
    T=[[G[mrows[i]][mcols[j]] if G[mrows[i]][mcols[j]]!=sep else None for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
    M=[]
    for i in range(R-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(C-1):
            w=[T[i][j],T[i][j+1],T[i+1][j],T[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(content if (None in w or len(set(w))>1) else w[0])

    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(len(M)) for j in range(len(M[0])) if M[i][j]!=content]
    if not nz: return []
    r0=min(p[0] for p in nz); r1=max(p[0] for p in nz); c0=min(p[1] for p in nz); c1=max(p[1] for p in nz)
    return [r[c0:c1+1] for r in M[r0:r1+1]]

def solve(G, verbose=False):
    H,W = len(G), len(G[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(x for row in G for x in row)
    content = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(G[r][c] not in (content,) and G[r].count(content)>0 and G[r][c]!=G[r][ (c+1)%W] or G[r][c] not in (content,) for c in range(W))]
    # simpler: marker rows = rows containing a value that is not content and not the row's dominant separator
    sep = None
    # separator color: the non-content color appearing in full lines
    nonc = Counter(x for row in G for x in row if x!=content)
    # markers: values that appear in < half of marker-row cells
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x!=content for x in G[r])]
    # determine separator = most common non-content value overall
    sep = nonc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x not in (content,sep) for x in G[r])]
    mcols=[c for c in range(W) if any(G[r][c] not in (content,sep) for r in range(H))]
    R,C=len(mrows),len(mcols)
    T=[[G[mrows[i]][mcols[j]] if G[mrows[i]][mcols[j]]!=sep else None for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
    M=[]
    for i in range(R-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(C-1):
            w=[T[i][j],T[i][j+1],T[i+1][j],T[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(content if (None in w or len(set(w))>1) else w[0])
        M.append(row)
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(len(M)) for j in range(len(M[0])) if M[i][j]!=content]
    if not nz: return []
    r0=min(p[0] for p in nz); r1=max(p[0] for p in nz); c0=min(p[1] for p in nz); c1=max(p[1] for p in nz)
    return [r[c0:c1+1] for r in M[r0:r1+1]]
